title: unitpopup
summary: MSUI carries current Benilla's backed SELF/PARTY/PLAYER tables and actions. The MENU surface follows UIDropDownMenu for the exact dark-navy tooltip-background multiply and white border, gold title/white action colors, 16px pitch, 15px borders, notCheckable and check-column seats, the full width-settle allowances, highlight/check/arrow/icon decoration, two-level parent-row anchoring and edge flips, open/row-click cues, click-away dismissal and the 5-second hover-away timeout. Loot method/threshold, master-looter promotion, raid-target submenus, range/death-gated Duel, and the client-side exact-name Follow row are live. Only the dedicated RAID-member menu remains deferred.

openItems.text: SELF menu now opens with Leave party, but the loot method/threshold submenus and loot-promote rows are still deferred (no CMSG_LOOT_METHOD sender)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Wired current Benilla level-2 loot method and quality threshold menus plus loot-master promotion through the existing CMSG_LOOT_METHOD sender; added raid-target parent/submenu with exact atlas cells, colors, checked state and MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE set/clear bodies.

openItems.text: No party-management rows: Invite, Uninvite, Promote, Leave
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-09: UnitPopupUiLaw menus + CMSG_GROUP_INVITE/UNINVITE_GUID/SET_LEADER/DISBAND wired through OpenUnitPopup; leader-gated per UnitPopup_HideButtons.
2026-08-09: Whisper row opens the chat edit prefilled '/w Name ' (ChatFrame_SendTell equivalent), caret parked at end.

PARTY and PLAYER menus now expose Duel when cooperative; the row grays at 10 yards or when either player is dead, and clicking casts the learned spell whose first effect is SPELL_EFFECT_DUEL (83) at that unit.

openItems.text: Follow row was a dead stub; now hidden outright (reference deferral pattern) until a follow movement mode exists — see systems/ui_follow
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: PARTY and PLAYER tables now place Follow exactly between Trade and Duel, hide it without cooperation, and click through exact-name StartAutoFollow into the client-only movement mode and status surface.

openItems.text: Trade row is not distance-gated (ref grays it beyond 11.11yd; only Inspect is gated in MSUI)
No auto-timeout/hover-away close; the card look is bespoke buttons rather than the vanilla menu rows
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: UnitPopup renders the tooltip backdrop with UIDropDownMenu's exact gold disabled title, white action rows, 16px pitch, 15px borders, notCheckable x-seat, text+45 auto width, viewport clamp, click-away and 5-second hover-away timeout.

openItems.text: The unit menu used the correct tooltip texture but drew it at an untinted white multiply, producing the wrong card color; its reference open and row-click cues were also absent.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: UnitPopupUiLaw now freezes GameTooltip.xml's TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_COLOR (0.09,0.09,0.19) and white border tint, and the renderer passes both to WowSkin.Tooltip. Unit-menu open emits igMainMenuOpen and actionable row/submenu clicks emit UChatScrollButton. Focused UnitPopup checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-compare the right-click player/party card's navy fill, white border, title/action/disabled colors, highlight additive blend and open/click cue cardinality against current Benilla.
